More4.uk.description: The competition begins at Village Limits in Woodhall Spa, Lincolnshire, where David and Kim hope to impress with their stylish rooms. But there's a bothersome bathroom and some cheeky chat.

More4.uk.description: Mother-and-daughter duo Zoe and Mea hope that their guests will lap up the luxury at The Old Mill in Yarm. But one pair think the extra cost for a deluxe room with a hot tub is a bit rich.

More4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
More4.uk.description: At The Elan Hotel in Powys, Martin and Iris offer a no-frills approach and a banging breakfast. But the rooms lack the wow factor, and Spencer and Gavin aren't fans of going back to basics.

More4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
More4.uk.description: The final visit is to The Royal Oak Inn in Somerset, run by Spencer and Gavin. After talking a good game all week, the guests are shocked to find the standards to be rather... standard.

More4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
More4.uk.description: On payment day, the guests rifle through their feedback, from troubles over a breakfast hamper to dodgy décor decisions. But at the end of it all, which B&B will reign supreme?

More4.uk.description: Keighley, West Yorkshire. The first host, no-nonsense healthcare worker Bev Stewart, takes her guests back to their school days with a menu of fish fingers, jelly and ice cream. (Ep1/5)

More4.uk.description: Keighley, West Yorkshire. Computer engineer Adam Bolam-Peel has plenty of surprises up his sleeve, from Northumbrian pipe playing to poetry writing. (Ep2/5)

More4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
More4.uk.description: Michael and his mum Lorna host at Edmund House in Deal, Kent. One guest is less than thrilled by the 'no-frills' experience, and others don't fancy the activity: competitive dog grooming.

More4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
More4.uk.description: Entrepreneur Mark hosts at the Five Bells Pub in Berkshire. But his guests don't all share his passion for beer - and is he too honest for his own good?
